title: 第19章 卜算第20章 灵堂
content_zh:
藏宝点位于赵国东南方向的一座无名岛屿上，距离水司寨足有数千里远无法直接飞渡
杨威便找到水运相关商队乘坐客商大船朝着目标地而去
在原本计划里炼气三重之时便要去取回资源，谁知因为兽潮的事情便耽搁了
如今已有的炼气六重修为去往藏宝地绰绰有余了，不过他有意将境界压到炼气二重，非筑基以上很难看出
在略微观察一番船上情况一切正常后杨威独自回了房间
坐在床榻之上他手中握着镜子其中映射出的是一张陌生的中年男人脸庞，虽然经常宅在家中水司寨都未必有几个人认识自己，但去藏宝地多少还是需要多次易容保险些。
夜深人静
一连三天的平稳让杨威稍微放松了些，正酣睡着突发的心慌感将他猛的惊醒
这种感觉杨威并不陌生，往往是危机来临之前的预兆
他修行过一门名为“太上感应术”
的福灵术法，可以略微感应到运势变化，趋吉避凶是最基本的
为了验证猜想，杨威当即便掏出三枚铜板进行周易卜卦
此卜算之法也是一门独特技艺，一般只有方士会学，第六世时杨威觉得有用便顺道拜师学了些皮毛
卜算同一天只可进行三次，多了便不灵了
只需在心中默念想要知道的事情便可通过卦象预知凶吉
“预测短期运势”
“叮当”
三枚铜板落在地上皆是反面朝上且落地的位置形成一个奇怪的爻相
“祸福相依”
上方是大吉之兆而下方又是大凶之兆

杨威又投掷一次结果还是一样，事不过三至此杨威无比确定马上可能发生与自身息息相关的变故
“难道是那魔修追来了？
杨威想着便干脆出门查看一番，他才刚走出门便感受浑身一阵乏力
“这是？
望着眼前的一幕杨威有些惊诧，之前还在闲聊走动的凡人们皆是栽倒在船板上并且生机还在不断流失
再朝窗外看去只见三道人影竖立在外，一道无形阵法已经形成将众人包裹其中
看三人站在不同方向，杨威便看出这是一道简易的一阶阵法
此阵法发动悄然无声，若非他意识灵敏此刻也中招了
“杀人啦，出人命啦！
杨威忽的大喊起来将那些还不曾被催眠唤醒
越快清醒过来的修士纷纷朝他这边赶来
在看清楚情况后，便有一名修士二话不说就破门而去想要先到外面再说，谁知他刚飞到结界处便被狠狠反弹回来
和杨威猜测的一样对方布置的这个阵法是有防护作用的，想要出去便只能打破阵法
他粗略的统计了一下，船上加他也不过五名修士，其中明面上修为最高的还是他这个炼气六重
而那三名敌人都有着炼气七到八重的实力，两者本就实力悬殊对方竟还求稳先利用阵法杀敌
“三位道友冤有头债有主，你们不能滥杀无辜啊”
一名炼气低段女子朝着门外三人喊话只是没人回应
阵法持续带来的催眠效果还在继续，令得更多的凡人倒下失去生机
几人也感到灵力正在缓慢从身体里抽出而阵法则变得越发牢固
此时五人中的一名男修气愤说道：“拼了大不了鱼死网破，杀出重围或许还有一线生机！

在他身边还有一男子应是他的同伴。
两人对视一眼后便朝着门口猛的扑去，一人拿斧一人握棰
在他俩的猛砸之下刚形成的阵法明显出现了晃动
content_en:
The treasure cache is located on an unnamed island in the southeast of Zhao State. It is thousands of miles away from Shuisizhai and cannot be crossed directly.
Yang Wei then found a caravan related to water transport and took a merchant ship to head towards the destination.
The original plan was to retrieve resources at the third level of Qi refining, but unexpectedly it was delayed due to the beast tide.
The current level of cultivation at the sixth level of Qi Refining is more than enough to go to the treasure place, but he deliberately lowered his level to the second level of Qi Refining. It is difficult to tell unless he is above the foundation building level.
After briefly observing the situation on the ship, everything was normal, Yang Wei returned to the room alone.
Sitting on the bed, he held a mirror in his hand, which reflected the face of a strange middle-aged man. Although he often stayed at home in Shui Sizhai and not many people knew him, he still needed to disguise himself multiple times to be safe when going to the treasure hunt.
Dead of night
Three consecutive days of stability made Yang Wei relax a little, but a sudden feeling of panic suddenly woke him up while he was soundly asleep.
This feeling is not unfamiliar to Yang Wei, it is often a sign before a crisis comes.
He practiced a skill called "Tai Shang Sensing Technique"
The blessing spirit technique can slightly sense the changes in fortune. It is the most basic to seek good luck and avoid bad luck.
In order to verify his conjecture, Yang Weidang even took out three copper plates to perform divination in the Book of Changes.
This divination method is also a unique skill. Generally, only alchemists can learn it. In his sixth life, Yang Wei thought it was useful and stopped by to learn a little bit about it.
You can only perform divination three times on the same day. If you do more, it will not work.
Just by silently reciting what you want to know in your mind, you can predict bad luck through hexagrams.
"Forecasting short-term fortune"
"ding dong"
Three copper plates fell to the ground, all with their reverse sides facing up, forming a strange shape.
"Misfortune and fortune depend on each other"
The top is a good omen and the bottom is a bad omen
Yang Wei threw the ball again and the result was still the same. At this point, Yang Wei was extremely sure that something closely related to him might happen soon.
"Is it the demon cultivator who is chasing me?
Yang Wei thought about it and simply went out to check. As soon as he walked out of the door, he felt a wave of weakness all over his body.
"Is this?
Looking at the scene in front of him, Yang Wei was a little surprised. The mortals who were chatting and walking before all fell on the board of the ship and their vitality continued to drain away.
Looking out the window again, I saw three figures standing outside, and an invisible formation had been formed to wrap everyone inside.
Seeing the three people standing in different directions, Yang Wei saw that this was a simple first-order formation.
This formation was activated silently. If not for his sharp consciousness, he would have been hit at this moment.
"It's killing people, it's killing people!
Yang Wei suddenly shouted and woke up those who had not yet been hypnotized.
The monks who woke up quickly rushed towards him.
After seeing the situation clearly, a monk broke through the door without saying a word and wanted to go outside first. Unexpectedly, he was rebounded hard as soon as he flew to the barrier.
As Yang Wei guessed, the formation set up by the opponent has a protective effect. If you want to get out, you can only break the formation.
He made a rough calculation and found that there were only five monks on board including him. Among them, he was the sixth level Qi Refining Leveler who apparently had the highest level of cultivation.
And those three enemies all have the strength of the seventh to eighth level of Qi refining. There is a huge gap in strength between the two, but the other party wants to be sure to use the formation to kill the enemy first.
"Three fellow Taoists have their own faults and debtors. You can't kill innocent people indiscriminately."
A woman with a low level of Qi Refining shouted to the three people outside the door, but no one responded.
The hypnotic effect brought about by the array continues, causing more mortals to fall down and lose their life.
Several people also felt that spiritual power was slowly being withdrawn from their bodies and the formation became stronger and stronger.
At this time, a male cultivator among the five people said angrily: "If we fight hard, we will lose everything, but there may be a glimmer of hope to break out of the siege!
There is a man beside him who should be his companion.
After the two looked at each other, they rushed towards the door, one holding an ax and the other holding a hammer.
The newly formed formation was obviously shaking under their heavy smashing.
